notes: dCapEnemy_c is the ONLY class of the ROM's 403 whose destructor variants straddle two modules: D1 and the constructor live in arm9 (0x02005d94..0x02006588), D2 and D0 here in ov002.

The TU defines no `~dCapEnemy_c()`: one out-of-line definition would emit the whole D1/D2/D0 group with the D1 copy at STB_GLOBAL, and isolation refuses to deadstrip a homed duplicate that is not vague linkage. D2 and D0 are instead hand-spelled extern "C" ABI bodies written D0-then-D2 so deferred codegen emits them D2, D0 in ROM order. No key function means no emitted vtable/RTTI/D1 at all, so no compiler-only policy rows are needed.
